get.description: Retrieve Client 'home screen' data. Returns detailed information about the Account including Network, Synch Module, and Camera Info.

200.description: Home screen data including account, networks, sync modules, cameras, and device limits.

get.description: Retrieve information about all networks associated with the authenticated account. This endpoint is deprecated in favor of the homescreen endpoint.

post.description: Arm the given network - that is, start recording/reporting motion events for enabled cameras. When this call returns, it does not mean the arm request is complete, the client must gather the command ID from the response and poll for the status of the command.

200.description: A command object. This call is asynchronous and is monitored by the Command Status API call using the returned Command Id.

post.description: Disarm the given network - that is, stop recording/reporting motion events for enabled cameras. When this call returns, it does not mean the disarm request is complete, the client must gather the command ID from the response and poll for the status of the command.

200.description: A command object. This call is asynchronous and is monitored by the Command Status API call using the returned Command Id.

get.description: Return the status of the given command. Most Camera and System/Module APIs make a call from the Blink Server to your local Synch Module. These calls are asynchronous and return a command object. Use the returned command id in these calls to poll for completion of the command using this API until the complete flag is true in the response.

200.description: Command status with completion flag and status information

post.description: Enable motion detection for the given Camera. Note: No motion detection or video recording will take place unless the system is armed.

200.description: A command object. This call is asynchronous and is monitored by the Command Status API call using the returned Command Id.

post.description: Disable motion detection for the given Camera.

200.description: A command object. This call is asynchronous and is monitored by the Command Status API call using the returned Command Id.
